MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

4. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

5. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.

6. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   B. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing games.

10. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of AND RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
